comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Root cause is the cache key missing the workspace id.

content.text: Root cause is the cache key missing the workspace id.
Steps to reproduce: open rate limit headers with a workspace that has more than one member.
Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
